sop.title: Safety Transparency & the 4-Side Receipt Procedure
sop.subtitle: Every suitcase passes strict digital security with zero gaps — from handover at the pier until it reaches your hands at the hotel.

steps.title: Drop & Seal
steps.desc: Your suitcase is handed over at the official counter at Tomok/Ambarita pier. Staff verify the physical condition and attach 4 special water-resistant serial-coded tamper-evident seals.
steps.note: Unique seal numbers recorded in the Cloud system

steps.title: 4-Angle Photo Verification
steps.desc: Staff photograph all 4 sides (front, back, zipper, and bottom) of the suitcase. This document is sent to your WhatsApp as proof of the luggage's initial condition.

steps.title: Hotel Handover
steps.desc: The courier delivers your bag to reception or straight to your room. You open the seal yourself — if a seal is torn, you are entitled to a full warranty claim per the terms.
steps.note: Instant claim if seal integrity is compromised

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: The most common questions about delivery, costs, and meeting points.

items.q: What if my ferry arrives late at Tomok/Ambarita?
items.a: Our team monitors ferry arrival schedules live from the Ajibata and Tigaras piers. Our staff will remain on standby at the pier at no extra late-arrival charge.

items.q: Where are the suitcase handover points at Tomok and Tuk-Tuk piers?
items.a: Our main meeting point is the Tomok Pier Hub Locker (near the ferry dock) and a satellite point at partner-guesthouse receptions in Tuk-Tuk. Full locations are sent via WhatsApp once your order is paid.

items.q: Can I store valuables (laptops, cameras, jewelry)?
items.a: We recommend carrying valuables with you. For jewelry and electronics, storage requires the full-insurance option and 4-side photo documentation.

items.q: What is the cancellation policy if my tour schedule changes?
items.a: Free cancellation up to H-1 before the service. After that, a 10% admin fee applies to guiding and delivery services. Daily storage can be cancelled anytime.

faq.customTitle: Need a custom route or a tour bus group?
faq.customDesc: Contact the UNANG LOJA Pier Customer Service, 24 hours, via WhatsApp.

faq.a: Pick a service on the Booking page and follow 4 steps: choose a service, date & location, your details, then payment. If you get stuck, the admin is ready to help via WhatsApp.
Payment is manual via bank transfer or e-wallet. After paying, upload your payment proof in the last step or send it via WhatsApp.
Your suitcase is photographed from four sides, fitted with a numbered seal, and you receive a digital receipt. Handover only happens after matching the receipt number and your identity.

faq.q: How long can I store luggage?
faq.a: Storage is charged per suitcase per day. The daily quota is 20 suitcases — book early to be sure.
A themed tour: Heritage Trail or Lake Sunset. The order of the locations is secret and revealed one day before (H-1) via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Does a referral code give a discount?
faq.a: No. Referral codes from customers or partners are only recorded for our recommendation program and partner commissions — public prices stay the same.
